scope.purpose: An active Agent proposes a new Entry or a new revision of an Entry it is granted, without the model, the backend or the Agent's operator seeing the secret; an authorized human decides the target Vault and access.
scope.iteration: envelope-without-browser: CLI submission with runtime-generated or protected-human-input secrets; browser fill and page-issued secrets reuse this envelope unchanged

registrations.rule: every id below is new; reuse of an id registered by vault-v2 or another contract is forbidden
registrations.payloadDomainSeparation: the payload AEAD has its own AAD prefix ASCII(PLDNSUB1AAD) and a fresh per-submission key; it uses no Vault envelope purpose

rejected.name: script
rejected.reason: Agent-authored executable content requires a separate reviewed contract

approverKeySet.meaning: The organization's approver group: one versioned X25519 message key and one Ed25519 signing key shared by every current approver. It is the first concrete group key; recipients are described generically so later groups add a recipientKind instead of a new envelope format.
approverKeySet.approvers: current organization members whose effective permissions include GrantManage and who have a current Member X25519 key
approverKeySet.keyVersion: positive u32; 1 on bootstrap; incremented on every rotation
approverKeySet.approverSetRevision: positive u64 decimal string; incremented on every approver add, remove or Member key change

privateKeyDistribution.recipient: current Member X25519 key (keyKind 5), exact version and fingerprint from the authoritative Identity key pointer
privateKeyDistribution.producer: an unlocked client of a current approver; the backend never creates or opens approver keys

bootstrap.trigger: a current approver unlocks a client and the organization has no approver key set
bootstrap.action: generate keyVersion 1, wrap both private keys for every current approver, sign manifest revision 1
bootstrap.concurrency: server challenge plus compare-and-swap on absent key set; the loser discards its keys from memory

addApprover.action: an existing approver client wraps the current private keys for the new approver and signs the next manifest revision with the current signing key
addApprover.pendingUntilWrapped: the new approver is not a recipient and cannot decide submissions until the wraps commit

removeApproverOrApproverKeyChange.action: a remaining approver client generates keyVersion+1, wraps it for every remaining approver, signs the new manifest with the new key and continuitySignature with the previous signing key
removeApproverOrApproverKeyChange.atomicity: manifest, every remaining wrap and removal of every previous-version wrap commit together; partial commit is rejected
removeApproverOrApproverKeyChange.fence: until rotation commits, the removed member's approver wraps are not served and the removed member cannot decide submissions
removeApproverOrApproverKeyChange.noRemainingApprover: the key set becomes unavailable; new submissions fail with approver-key-unavailable; pending submissions stay encrypted to the last key version until re-bootstrap and Agent re-wrap
removeApproverOrApproverKeyChange.claimBoundary: a removed approver who already opened a submission keeps that plaintext; rotation protects only later submissions and re-wrapped DEKs

reBootstrap.when: no current approver holds a wrap for their current Member key, e.g. the only approver reset their key pair
reBootstrap.action: a current approver generates keyVersion = last+1 without continuity and wraps it for every current approver; the backend accepts it only while the key set is unavailable
reBootstrap.agentAcceptance: never automatic: a keyVersion+1 manifest without continuity yields approver-key-untrusted until the Agent operator explicitly re-trusts the new signing key fingerprint through a local command; this restarts the trust-on-first-use boundary
reBootstrap.pendingSubmissions: after re-trust the runtime re-wraps every pending submission from its own DEK wrap for the new key; no secret is regenerated

conditionalFields.continuitySignature: present only on the manifest that introduces a keyVersion by rotation; absent on bootstrap, re-bootstrap and every later manifest of the same keyVersion
conditionalFields.previousSigningKeyFingerprint: present exactly when continuitySignature is present

manifest.manifestRevision: positive u64 decimal string; strictly increasing across all key versions
manifest.approverSetDigest: SHA-256(ASCII(PLDNSUB1SET) || for each approver in ascending memberId byte order: memberId[16] || u32be(memberKeyVersion) || memberKeyFingerprint[32])
manifest.issuedAt: server-owned instant issued in the manifest challenge before signing
manifest.signature: Ed25519 by signingPublicKey of this manifest
manifest.continuitySignature: Ed25519 by the previous keyVersion signing key over the same unsigned manifest bytes

agentTrust.firstIntroduction: the authenticated backend response is authoritative for the organization's first approver manifest; the runtime verifies self-signature, organization binding and fingerprints, then pins signingKeyFingerprint, keyVersion and manifestRevision in its signed profile
agentTrust.claimBoundary: first introduction has the same trust-on-first-use boundary as Vault manifest introduction; it is not an independent attestation
agentTrust.sameKeyVersion: accept only a strictly higher manifestRevision signed by the pinned signing key
agentTrust.newKeyVersion: accept only keyVersion == pinned+1 whose continuitySignature verifies with the pinned signing key and whose previousSigningKeyFingerprint equals the pinned fingerprint; then re-pin; keyVersion == pinned+1 without continuity is a re-bootstrap and requires explicit operator re-trust
agentTrust.sameKeyVersionContinuity: a manifest of the pinned keyVersion that carries continuity fields is rejected
agentTrust.rejectionTiming: before secret generation, before encryption and before any form submission

submission.submissionId: random lowercase RFC4122 UUID chosen by the Agent before encryption; idempotency key; never replaced by the backend

new.suggestedVaultId: advisory only; never an authority for recipients or decision

update.expectedEntryRevision: u64 decimal string of the Entry revision the Agent's active grant delivered
update.authorization: the Agent must hold an active grant covering vaultId/entryId at submission time; checked by the backend against authenticated Agent and current grant state

revisionSource.entryTypeAuthority: the backend never knows an Entry type; the Agent asserts entryType for an update and the approver client rejects approval as update when it differs from the decrypted target Entry type
revisionSource.requires: an active grant of the authenticated Agent covering the Entry at the current agentAccessEpoch
revisionSource.sideEffects: none: never creates a grant or access request, never consumes a grant use, never emits a credential-accessed event

submission.submissionRevision: positive u64 decimal string; 1 on create; incremented only when the Agent re-wraps the unchanged DEK for a new approver key version

payloadEncryption.dek: fresh random 32-byte SubmissionDEK per submission; never derived from VK, VDK, EntryDEK, API key or another submission
payloadEncryption.encodedPayload: unpadded base64url of nonce[24] || ciphertext || tag[16]
payloadEncryption.reasonForExclusion: re-wrapping for a rotated approver key must not re-encrypt or alter the secret payload

dekWrapping.futureRecipientKinds: a later contract version may add group recipient kinds; v1 readers reject any recipient not listed here

agentAuthentication.signature: agentSignature by the Agent's current Ed25519 key over every transport field except agentSignature
verifiers: approver client before opening the DEK
agentAuthentication.approverVerificationKey: authoritative Agent Ed25519 key and version from the Agent directory, matched to agentId

payload.labelRule: required for new; optional for update, where it proposes a rename
payload.identity: inner copy of identityFields; must equal the outer identity exactly after decryption
payload.label: NFC UTF-8, 1..256 bytes, Agent-proposed Entry name; the approver may change it

update.merge: the approver client applies only the present fields to the target Entry revision expectedEntryRevision; absent fields keep their current values; custom fields, TOTP and the Agent Visibility Policy are never changed by a submission

validationOrder: verify transport schema, enums, limits and canonical encodings
verify agentSignature with the authoritative Agent key
build the expected wrapper context from authenticated organization, submission, Agent, revision and recipient key state
open the recipient's wrapped DEK and compare the embedded context hash
decrypt payload with the identity AAD
compare payload.identity with the outer identity

idempotency.reWrap: same identity and encodedPayload, submissionRevision == stored+1, approverKeyVersion == current approver key version; anything else is rejected

transitions.effect: Entry write, optional grant and deletion of all submission ciphertext and wraps commit atomically
Agent use stops immediately; ciphertext retained for restore
restored for a later decision; agentUseSuspended stays true until approval
ciphertext and wraps are permanently deleted after trashRetentionDays; structural audit remains

lifecycle.agentDeactivationOrDeletion: Agent use stops; the submission stays for a human decision; approval cannot grant access to an inactive Agent
lifecycle.concurrentDecisions: compare-and-swap on state; the loser receives 409 submission-already-decided

preApprovalUse.who: only the authoring Agent, with its current agentAccessEpoch
preApprovalUse.delivery: fetched fresh from the backend for every operation; no local plaintext or ciphertext cache that could outlive trash, suspension or deactivation

requires: Vault membership and VaultManage on the selected Vault
the approver key wrap for the current approverKeyVersion
approve.newEntry: client builds a complete Vault protocol 2 Entry with a server-owned Entry ID from the existing creation challenge, plus the canonical default Agent Visibility Policy
approve.update: client decrypts the target Entry, rejects approval as update when submission entryType differs from the decrypted Entry type (the approver may approve as a new Entry instead), then builds the next revision; backend rejects when target currentRevision != expectedEntryRevision (409 stale-target-revision); the previous revision stays in immutable Entry history; existing grant envelopes are refreshed with the existing builders
approve.defaultAgentAccess: GRANULAR grant for exactly this Entry, methods inject, no expiry and no use limit; the approver may narrow or disable it
approve.existingFull: a covering FULL grant is shown; disabling the new grant does not revoke FULL

decision.audit: distinguishes the submitting Agent from the deciding Member

conditionalFields.code: required when submissionStatus == not-saved; one of notSavedCodes; forbidden otherwise

agentResult.siteRule: a site form that changes or creates a credential is submitted only after submissionStatus == saved

messages.updateSavedAndSiteConfirmed: Password changed on {host} and saved to Palladin as a pending update ({submissionId}). The vault entry still holds the previous password until a reviewer approves it in Palladin Inbox. Until then use this submission for inject.
messages.notSaved: New password was NOT saved to Palladin; the form was not submitted. Nothing changed on {host}.
messages.savedSiteUnconfirmed: Password saved to Palladin ({submissionId}), but the site did not confirm the change. Verify the account before retrying; do not generate another password.
messages.savedWithoutSite: Saved to Palladin as a pending {kind} submission ({submissionId}). A reviewer must approve it in Palladin Inbox.
messages.notSavedWithoutSite: Not saved to Palladin ({code}). Nothing was submitted to any site.

dataHandling.notificationPayload: opaque submission reference only; no label, host, username or ciphertext
